message.content: Review PR #412. Focus on cache invalidation when a chart moves between teams. Don't change files.

src/charts/cache.ts: cache keys now include team_id
src/charts/move.ts: deletes the old team's cache before updating ownership
db/migrations/0042_backfill_team_ids.sql: fills existing cache rows
The move path invalidates the old key inside the same transaction as the ownership update. I'll check the rollback case and access from the previous team.

8 pass · 0 fail
Includes failed-move rollback and previous-team access denial.

No blocking findings in PR #412.

The old team's cache key is removed transactionally, and rollback restores it if the move fails. The access check runs before cache lookup, so the previous team cannot read the moved chart. All 8 focused tests passed.

One deployment note: apply 0042 before enabling the new query. Existing rows need team IDs. I left the working tree unchanged.
